entries.english:
1. Letter from the widowed Frau von Crailsheim to Albrecht von Rosenberg concerning her claim for a debt from the knighthood, Hornburg, 30 June 1641 (copy); 2. letter from Albrecht von Crailsheim to the brothers Hans Philipp and Philipp Jakob von Crailsheim zu Hornberg concerning measures against his rebellious subjects at Braunsbach and the inflammatory sermons of preacher Rößler at Hall, Braunsbach, 22 March 1583 (original, autograph); 3. reply from the captaincy to Valentin von Berlichingen concerning his dispute with Sebastian von Crailsheim, 3 January 1586 (copy); 4. letter from Dr Stephanus Baumann to Captain of Knights Wolfgang von Crailsheim concerning a loan, 31 May 1628 (original, autograph), among other items.

Dates: 1583–1641

Extent: 1 file.
